source: Seoul Metropolitan Area integrated distance-based fare, effective 2025-06-28 (Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport notice, 2025-06-19).

lineSurcharges.shinbundang: Shinbundang Line adds a separate surcharge on top of the distance fare.
lineSurcharges.arex: AREX all-stop trains use their own distance fare; AREX Express (direct train, Seoul Station ↔ Incheon Airport) needs a separate ticket and does not take T-money.
lineSurcharges.gtx-a: GTX-A uses its own, higher fare table.
lineSurcharges.yongin: Yongin EverLine is privately operated and may add a surcharge.
lineSurcharges.uijeongbu: Uijeongbu LRT is privately operated and may add a surcharge.
lineSurcharges.maglev: Incheon Airport Maglev operation status changes; check before travelling.
